correctness.rationale: In the repaired statement the reflexive descendant cone of x must map onto the successor cone of f(x). A leaf maps to a top; a top-valued vertex has one leaf color by forth, and a bottom-valued vertex has every color on leaves by back followed by descent from each top witness. In the converse, nested palettes give forth, leaves witness the tops and a bottom-valued vertex witnesses itself. Thus the bijection and all three recurrence cases follow. Collapsing unary vertices deletes only duplicate support tests. A reduced nonstar with at least k≥3 leaves has a branching vertex with a child subtree containing s≥2 leaves and t≥1 outside. Taking h=max(2,k−t) gives h≤s and 2≤h≤k−1, with k−h≤t. Hence one can use exactly h colors inside and all other colors outside, obtaining a globally onto coloring that cannot extend. A star passes every global onto assignment, with endpoints ℓ<k or k=2 correctly treated. The recurrence gives positive excess over k iff a child has positive excess or the local arity is at least k. Each binary ancestor multiplies ternary excess 6 by 3. For ℓ=4 the reduced degree budget sum(d−1)=3 gives the four values 3,9,21,39; at any ℓ≥4 the balanced split and caterpillar split give distinct full-binary shapes. These facts remain valid as consequences; the repair changes the novelty scope, not the attachment test cases.
residual_risks: The finite record is supporting evidence only. The proof distinguishes unary stems from proper subtrees of the reduced star; it does not transfer to immediate-parent accessibility.

value.rationale: The repair answers a structural question about a simple but nondiscrete target: which leaf assignments actually generate bounded maps, and exactly which shapes impose no obstruction beyond onto versus constant? The strict equality characterization distinguishes all genuine nested branch shapes from the reduced star at a fixed leaf count; computing counts for individual pairs or matching a few profile values does not supply it.
residual_risks: The result addresses two-level fans and one accessibility relation. It does not make the numerical profile a complete shape invariant.
